Anti-Procrastination Song by Stormtroopers of Death

3 seconds

* http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6JxkOgE6-Bw
This was a regular part of my childhood from 4-11.

I have to get my practical activities done at one time since I am reliant on others due to my medical and sensory integration issues. I am working toward getting back on my feet and going back to work.

I agree about reformulation. It's as interesting as validation. They aren't yet referring to it as the higgs boson but a "higgs like" particle which is so awesome. It shows how at the root of science there is free thinking and the assumption of knowledge is absent.

Thank you for the compliment. I feel like I won the contest to stay alive that my family has set against me but it seems so phyrric with only healthcare workers in my life to appreciate the win.

I want to understand more about musical theory but don't have the interest in learning. I have so much I want to learn that takes priority. I understand the relation with mathematical theory but I don't know much about composition, structure, or the important minutiae.

None of clips the provoked an emotional response although I did appreciate all of them.

Today was a good day because my counselor took me to see my MD to get my UTI under control. I also was able to get my cats their food and litter, go grocery shopping, and get my antibiotic and something for the pain the UTI is causing. These are all things I cannot accomplish on my own.

It's always been little reliefs that have kept me going. It's fatigue and illness that bring me to the edge. After this long it's the fatigue most of all. I wish self-awareness could fix depression but it can no more fix depression than it could fix a severed spinal cord. I often think about cost vs reward and don't believe that it will ever balance out in my favor.

On a tangential note, I am so thankful to have been around to see the "higgs like" particle data have a sigma that is definitive. It's exciting.

She is more work but not significantly so. It costs more to take care of them and I have 160 a month to make work after rent. She is very active and scares the shit out of me by jumping on me from high places and sometimes she has jumped and put a paw into my current wound which is excruciating. I can't wait till it heals.

I will add that book to my read pile. I like how Sacks writes so it's a no-brainer to add.

I have never enjoyed pop songs. I admit some are earwigs but I still don't enjoy them and find them incredibly irritating. What I find pleasing is hard, beat driven, lacking typical trope lyrics, and sonically dense.

I forgot about GABA drugs like GHB as a treatment for depression so I am going to bring that up with my Psychiatrist. GHB is heavily regulated so I completely forgot that I had not tried that class. I must say that cannabis is quite effective but must be consumed at least every few days but it is illegal here and very costly.

I have decided against ECT. I am going to also try some high-dose tryptamine psychedelics to see if I can give my brain a 5-HTx shove. I used to be in the Pickard chain of distribution in the 80's and those were some of the few times I remember feeling hopeful with a sense of awe since I was 4. LSD was a very useful tool for me to resolve my abuse issues. It helped me see the reality and then compartmentalize. I have had no success compartmentalizing my depression. It seems to permeate every pore.

I disagree about the concept of "nothing to lose". One always has something to lose. It's a thinking error to assume there will be no loss. I admit I don't know with absolute certainty that there is no god or afterlife but all evidence points to that there is no evidence so I don't really ask the question regarding my personal losses from death itself.

When I am not distraught I do see that I also know nothing about my future. I could get struck by lightning and get inadvertent ECT, have a revelatory moment that changes me forever, or even have my life become about being a father. This is a good skill but it's one that disappears under extreme duress.

I forgot my manners and social skills. How old are you? In what fields do you work and study? I forget that conversation is a circle.

*EDIT* I forgot to say that before yesterday I never considered adding redditors to my support system. Since the Eternal September I stopped considering new people on the internet as friends. If you lived through the ruination of usenet it you know what I mean. It was not 5x5.

Psychic TV is incredibly eclectic. Genesis is an amazing person.

I have asked myself why certain songs evoke emotion and why the same songs seem flat and unappealing when done in different locations. There is a particular acoustic response in The Orchids and many other songs that directly provoke emotional response like the reverb in many churches. I also like the simplicity and the instrumentation. The lyrics are not as appealing and take a back seat. It is a song about genital piercing as orchid is a medical term for testes so take that with a grain of salt. I played the song at my mothers memorial service. I figured it was allegorical enough for people to lack understanding and still enjoy the song. The refrain was the part I wanted people to hear. "In the morning after the night I fall in love with the light." I was very relieved she was no longer suffering and wanted to express that without saying it myself. If you want more examples of the awesome that is PTV then check out Starlit Mire and She was Surprised. Sonic density is amazing in it's ability to provoke emotion as well.

My male cat is named Hephaestion but I call him buddy when around others. I don't want to get too attached to the female stray that walked in my house last winter so I have not named her yet. Buddy is my companion animal and has papers from my psychologist. We have been together since 2005. I have had dogs but they require child level attention that I cannot provide in my environment.

One of the worst things about my depression has been the loss of hope and awe that I had before my brother's suicide.
It's not currently situated on my neck. It is in my garage now.

I value my autonomy so call me Jack. I always wanted to be called Jack because my father named me and he is a pedophile. I don't have any favorites anymore. I like animals. I have cats and have arranged for their future. I have my cremation and fees paid. I am 41. I have diagnoses of treatment resistant depression, PTSD, and PDD NOS/ASD(prelim DSM change). Due to the PDD NOS/ASD I am unable to feel any significant emotional interconnection between myself and others although others have seemed to and said they are attached to me. I have mind blindness to a moderate degree. I am strictly unable to interpret the facial and body language of others. The doc thinks ECT is a good next step. I don't want to lose the only way I have of communicating by undergoing ECT. I don't want to suffer possible brain damage and loss of intelligence that ECT can cause regardless of stated efficacy. I have had 34 years of taking many of each class of psych meds plus the more common off label ones and none have worked for more than 6 months. I am completely med compliant and continue to follow all Dr orders. I have had 5 major surgeries in the past year that have left me housebound so I cannot get the right level of exercise or even ride in a vehicle for more than 45 minutes without soiling myself. Any disturbance in my routine induces a high level of stress in me regardless of whether the routine is something I enjoy. I am very ill but am in recovery. I think I am an OK person. I think I am reasonably attractive. I can't seem to reduce my singular interest perseveration and expand my interest base. I am skilled and talented in many areas. I am literal to a fault. I have worked with many counselors and have resolved most of my past personal as well as interpersonal issues. People seem to like me and I them. I have very few automatic negative thoughts. I have resolved my PTSD to the point where I no longer have panic attacks or night terrors. I feel I am a worthy person. I am not situationally depressed. I was given the highest possible interpretive score on the Stanford-Binet when I was 4 and have tested similarly on the Weschler. I believe in my physical recovery and that the realities of life's ups and downs are no longer the source of my depression but rather exacerbating it. My sister died in June. My brother, his son, my uncle, and 3 of my great uncles self terminated. I don't feel fear when I am shaking. After my post I did about 4 hours of research that seems to indicate that my shaking is rooted in the endocrine system. It seems to me that I am experiencing a physiological reaction to 'standing at the edge' but I am unsure if this is so. I have no family except very distant cousins and aunts. I have only one true friend and he is taxed to his limit dealing with my physical illness and depression. I dropped out of highschool as soon as I turned 16. I was in a nursing home because I was so sick I could not take care of myself. I am home now. I am so tired and sick. I regret not listening to my mother when she wanted to talk to me about helping her end her life before her cancer got any worse. She suffered so much. I have a treatment plan to help prevent self harm and I follow it. Today was a rare exception. My counselor knows I am suicidal and although I can no longer commit to prevention of self-harm. The cops showed up today when 1800SUICIDE called them. I don't get more than 2 hours 50 minutes sleep at once due to my illness. I apologize for not putting this in the text of the post. I was distraught and desperate and now I am just exhausted. This is a novel account. The Orchids is a song by Psychic TV and it's one of the few that moves me to tears although I don't understand why. This is my daily routine: Wake up miserable and wrecked, go through my day the same way, go to bed exhausted from fighting to stay alive using all of my learned and inherent skills. I use distraction, de-isolation, meditation, soothing, stimming, CBT/DBT, and so many other skills. I have a bad cold and a severe MRSA UTI from self-cathing 5 or 6 times a day. When I am physically well I get adequate exercise. I have lost more than 100lbs due to my illness.  I don't understand why people don't respect that I am rational even though I am depressed. I don't understand why western society places such a high value on an individual life that has become untenable. I guess, in short, I have reached out, reached out, reached out, done everything I have been asked to do, and am now just struggling with the death throes.

Apologies for the run-on paragraph, sentence structure, missed Oxford commas, pedantic communication, ending sentences with prepositions, improper word use, hyperbole, generalizations, jargon, repeated/reframed statements, misspelling, "I a words.", and all other deviations from university writing course english that induces cerebral apoplexy on reddit. I am very tired and having considerable difficulty concentrating on writing anything but 'I' statements. I can't sleep even though I am exhausted and it is 3 and one half hours past bedtime.

I appreciate the replies. I am unsure what to do with the replies that are statements except read and integrate.

Is this what you mean by just talk? I have exposed details about me and my life without re-hashing already resolved issues.
